# HTS Design System — Release 1

## 1.0.1

Compatible maintenance release of all seven coordinated packages.
It repairs Alert no-icon placement, Select caret geometry,
backdrop-independent focus visibility, CSS cascade guidance, and
duplicate static-font packaging without adding or removing a public
selector, property, export, token, theme, or component contract.
Qualification evidence is namespaced under `docs/testing/v1.0.1/`.
